summary.text: The three fires and three waters are rank nine immortal materials of heaven and earth, stocked by Heavenly Court.

claims.text: Granny Sha names three fires and three waters in this world and states that they are all rank nine immortal materials, with Heavenly Court holding stock of all of them. When those three waters are brought for a dying Heavenly Court senior, they have no effect, and true dragon heavenly water is used instead.

In The Legends of Ren Zu, a snowman claims to have conquered the bright light glorious ring fire in the sky, the azure divine stone furnace fire in the earth, and the raging wave rising dragon fire in the sea. The snowman later names the heat, heaviness, and chaos of those three fires when comparing the fire of love.

Nine heavenly star sweat is one of the three waters of heaven and earth, along with myriad being creation water and rising falling tide water. It is a rank nine immortal material of extreme value, rare even among rank nine immortal materials. Unlike the three fires of heaven and earth, nine heavenly star sweat among the three waters has already vanished, because seven of the nine heavens are gone and only two remain.

The three flames of heaven, earth, and human are the heaven flame bright light glorious ring fire, the earth flame azure divine stone furnace fire, and the human flame raging wave rising dragon fire. They are rank nine unique flames of heaven, earth, and human.
